title: RBI invites comments on the draft “Reserve Bank of India (Non-Banking Financial Companies – Credit Facilities) Amendment Directions, 2026”
description: The Reserve Bank of India today released the draft “Reserve Bank of India (Non-Banking Financial Companies – Credit Facilities) Amendment Directions, 2026”. Comments/feedback on the draft Amendment Directions are invited from regulated entities and other interested stakeholders by August 28, 2026.
